QUOTE: Each handler is a mixin function of the form `const XHandler = <TBase extends Constructor<ServerDataOperatorBase>>(superclass) => class extends superclass {...}`. ... Every handler write funnels through `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords`, which is the single `database.write(...)` call.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that each mixin is constrained to extend ServerDataOperatorBase (which extends BaseDataOperator) and that all handler writes go through the inherited `batchRecords`.
